item.title: Delhi HC Quashes Income Tax Notices against NDTV Founders, Slaps ₹2 Lakh Costs on Department
item.description: While noting that no amount of costs can truly compensate for the harassment caused by such proceedings, the Court imposed a token cost of ₹1 lakh each payable to Dr. Roy and Ms. Roy.

item.title: ICAI Reschedules CA Intermediate Paper 5 (Auditing & Ethics): Check New Date Here
item.description: Two days back, the ICAI postponed the examination due to some unavoidable circumstances.

item.title: Failure to appoint Internal Auditor: MCA Slaps ₹2.5 Lakh Penalty on Company and its Director [Read Order]
item.description: As the auditor was appointed after the time period, the registrar held the company and its officer in default liable for penalty for the period 01.04.2022 to 14.11.2024 (958 days).

item.title: CA Fails to Disclose Public Deposit Liabilities, Asset Ever-Greening: Delhi HC Upholds Three-Month Name Removal from ICAI Register [Read Order]
item.description: It was observed that Charges 1 and 2 were particularly grave, as they involved misrepresentation of liabilities and failure to detect asset inflation

item.title: No Capital Gain Tax in JDA Execution Year without Consideration & with Limited Possession: ITAT [Read Order]
item.description: If the possession given by the landowners to the developer was only for the limited purpose of development and that no consideration had been received during the year of execution of the JDA, no taxable capital gains arose under section 45(1) of the Act in that year.

item.title: Payments for Live Telecast of Cricket Matches without Enduring Benefit Not Taxable as Royalty: Delhi HC in Sri Lanka Cricket Case [Read Order]
item.description: The court held that Royalty requires enduring rights, payments for live telecast of cricket matches without recording or reuse rights are not taxable as royalty

item.title: Refund arises out of Excise Duty Demand Deletion must be Claimed through Separate Statutory Procedure, Not Before Tribunal: CESTAT [Read Order]
item.description: CESTAT dismisses appeal. Refund from deletion of excise duty demand to be claimed from separate proceedings.

item.title: Arm-Blade Assembly without Motor Classified as Parts, Not Complete Wiper: CESTAT [Read Order]
item.description: CESTAT held that an Arm‑Blade Assembly without motor is classifiable as parts under CTH 8512, not as a complete windscreen wiper.

item.title: 800 Days Delay in Filing Statement of Affairs: Karnataka HC Holds Official Liquidator’s Recovery Application Barred By Limitation [Read Order]
item.description: The court held that a recovery claim based on a statement of affairs filed after an 800-day delay is barred by limitation

item.title: ESOP Cost allowable as Business Expenditure u/s 37: ITAT allows Yatra’s ₹93L Claim Despite same Issue Pending before SC [Read Order]
item.description: The Delhi High Court in Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd. had already held that ESOP cost is allowable as revenue expenditure and the tribunal has applied the same ruling here.
